title: Assessing the gains from moving along the global value chain: Evidence from Costa Rica’s electronics sector
title_zh: 评估沿全球价值链移动的收益：来自哥斯达黎加电子部门的证据
authors: Alessandro Maravalle & Elena Vidal Muñoz
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a framework to evaluate the potential economic gains from deeper participation in global value chains (GVCs). The approach combines measures of revealed comparative advantage with estimates of value-added distribution along GVCs to identify opportunities for upgrading into higher–value-added production stages. It then quantifies the long-term economic effects of such upgrading using a structural gravity model. The framework is applied to Costa Rica’s electronics sector, a key focus of the country’s strategy to expand its role in the semiconductor value chain. The findings indicate that strengthening Costa Rica’s position within the electronics GVC could lead to substantial long-term increases in exports, output, and real wages.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个评估深度参与全球价值链（GVCs）潜在经济收益的分析框架。该框架将显性比较优势指标与全球价值链中增加值分布的估算相结合，以识别向更高附加值生产阶段升级的机遇，进而运用结构引力模型量化此类升级的长期经济效应。将该框架应用于哥斯达黎加电子行业——该国扩大半导体价值链参与战略的核心领域，研究结果表明：强化哥斯达黎加在电子全球价值链中的地位，可带来出口、产出与实际工资的长期显著增长。

title: Conservation outcomes across protected area strategies: Insights from a longitudinal analysis of the Brazilian National System of Conservation Units
title_zh: 不同保护区策略的保护成效：基于巴西国家保护区系统纵向分析的见解
authors: Clarisse Carmo, Alberto Fonseca
abstract: Assessing land use and land cover dynamics in protected areas (PA) is fundamental to understanding how different conservation strategies influence outcomes across distinct territorial contexts. The present study provided one of the most comprehensive longitudinal assessments of the PAs under the Brazilian System of Nature Conservation Units, through geospatial statistical analysis of land use and cover variations between 1985 and 2022, drawing on an ad hoc Natural Cover Dynamics Index (NCDI). The results revealed persistent conversion of natural areas within Brazilian PAs, including strictly protected categories, with agricultural expansion emerging as the main driver of natural cover loss. Findings also indicated differences in conservation performance among PA categories, reinforcing broader theoretical and political debates around forest transition theory and land sparing versus land sharing strategies. Beyond providing large-scale empirical evidence on conservation outcomes in Brazil, the analytical framework developed in this study contributes to policy-oriented assessments aimed at improving strategic conservation planning and the effectiveness of protected area system. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 评估保护区（PA）的土地利用与土地覆盖动态变化，对于理解不同保护策略如何在特定地域背景下影响保护成效至关重要。本研究基于1985年至2022年间土地利用与覆盖变化的时空统计分析，并借助特设的自然覆盖动态指数（NCDI），对巴西国家自然保护单位体系下的保护区进行了最为全面的纵向评估之一。结果显示，巴西保护区内（包括严格保护类别）的自然区域持续被转化，农业扩张成为自然覆盖丧失的主要驱动因素。研究还发现不同保护区类别在保护绩效上存在差异，这进一步强化了围绕森林转型理论以及土地节约与土地共享策略的广泛理论与政策辩论。除为巴西保护成效提供大规模实证证据外，本研究构建的分析框架还有助于开展面向政策导向的评估，旨在优化战略性保护规划并提升保护区体系的有效性。

title: Hurricanes, Climate Change Policies and Electoral Accountability
title_zh: 飓风、气候变化政策与选举问责
authors: Gagliarducci, Stefano, Paserman, M. Daniele, Patacchini, Eleonora
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the conditions under which legislators promote policies that may be unpopular in the short term but yield long-term benefits. Using data on the universe of federal disaster declarations from 1989 to 2020, we document that representatives from congressional districts impacted by hurricanes are more inclined to support environmental legislation addressing climate change. However, this response depends on political circumstances: only those in safe seats can change their political agenda towards policies that involve short-term costs for long-term gains. These results highlight the role of electoral incentives in shaping politicians’ attitudes towards far-sighted policy making.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了立法者在何种条件下会推动短期内可能不受欢迎但能带来长期利益的政策。利用1989年至2020年联邦灾害声明的全样本数据，我们发现，受飓风影响的国会选区代表更倾向于支持应对气候变化的环境立法。然而，这种反应取决于政治环境：只有处于安全席位的代表才能将政治议程转向涉及短期成本但带来长期收益的政策。这些结果凸显了选举激励在塑造政治家对远见政策制定态度中的作用。

title: Voting Choice
title_zh: 投票选择
authors: Andrey Malenko, Nadya Malenko
abstract: Abstract Traditionally, fund managers cast votes on behalf of fund investors. Recently, there is a shift toward “pass-through voting,” with funds offering investors a choice: delegate votes to the fund or vote themselves. We develop a framework to study the implications of voting choice. While it helps reflect heterogeneous investor preferences, it also shapes the informational content of the vote, and these forces can conflict. When interests are aligned, voting choice improves information aggregation and investor welfare. With preference heterogeneity or costly information, however, it can make investors worse off by weakening informed. (JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22)
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统上，基金经理代表基金投资者行使投票权。近期出现向“穿透式投票”的转变，基金为投资者提供选择：将投票权委托给基金或自行投票。我们构建了一个分析框架研究投票选择的影响。虽然投票选择有助于反映异质性投资者偏好，但也会塑造投票的信息含量，这两种力量可能相互冲突。当利益一致时，投票选择能改善信息聚合与投资者福利。然而，在偏好异质性或信息成本存在的情况下，投票选择可能因削弱知情投票而降低投资者福利。（JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22）

title: Mapping socio-ecological factors, built-up expansion and land use change: Spatial analysis and insights for planning and restoration
title_zh: 社会生态因素、建成区扩张与土地利用变化的空间分析：规划与修复的启示
authors: Yana Prados, Skaloš Jan, Hossein Azadi
abstract: Urban development is perceived as an indicator of economic advancement and opportunity. However, rapid BUA expansion exerts land pressure, acting as a catalyst for land-use and land-cover (LULC) changes. This study examined the role of socio-environmental factors, including landscape types (LTs), geomorphology and topography, in BUA dynamics and LULC changes across urban, peri-urban and rural areas between 1842 and 2019. The spatial analysis for sixty randomly selected study sites (a total of 24,000 ha), located in the Central European region, employed ArcGIS tools, integrating historical cadastral maps (Stable Cadastre, 1842) with CORINE LULC data (2019), and statistical techniques, including Binomial Logistic Regression. Findings revealed that total BUA increased by 84.7%, mainly in warm lowlands, primarily replacing arable land (67.23% of the total LULC changes). The built-up growth encompassed a mixed-sized building ranging from 4 to 32,488 m 2 per unit through infill and edge expansion in urban areas (100–500 m distance from the historical built‑up fabric), and small-sized, clustered (0–50 m distance) BUA expansion around rural settlement cores. The Hot Spot Analysis (Getis-Ord Gi*) of recent BUA shows predominant clustering of large-sized buildings in the lowlands, which together account for 33.15%. Population density across 4–11 categories emerged as the most influential predictor. The study demonstrated that the socio-ecological factors act as opportunities (uniform topography of warm lowlands) and constraints (complex topography of cold highlands) for BUA expansion. From a land‑use policy perspective, the study prioritises spatially adaptive, ecologically integrated land‑use governance and restoration strategies in response to accelerating socio‑environmental change.
abstract_zh: 城市发展被视为经济进步与机遇的指标。然而，建成区（BUA）的快速扩张对土地造成压力，成为土地利用与土地覆盖（LULC）变化的催化剂。本研究考察了1842年至2019年间，包括景观类型（LTs）、地貌与地形在内的社会-环境因素在城市、城郊及农村地区的BUA动态与LULC变化中的作用。研究选取中欧地区60个随机样点（总面积24,000公顷），运用ArcGIS工具整合历史地籍图（1842年稳定地籍图）与CORINE LULC数据（2019年），并结合二项逻辑回归等统计方法进行分析。结果显示，BUA总面积增长84.7%，主要集中于温暖低地，其中耕地被替代占LULC总变化的67.23%。建成区扩张包含混合规模建筑（单体面积4至32,488平方米），通过城市区域（距历史建成区100–500米）的填充与边缘扩展，以及农村聚落核心周边小规模、集群式（0–50米距离）BUA扩张实现。近期BUA的热点分析（Getis-Ord Gi*）显示，大型建筑主要聚集于低地，占比达33.15%。人口密度（4–11个类别）成为最具影响力的预测因子。研究表明，社会-生态因素既构成BUA扩张的机遇（温暖低地均匀地形），也形成制约（寒冷高地复杂地形）。从土地利用政策视角，本研究优先提出空间适应性、生态整合的土地利用治理与恢复策略，以应对加速的社会-环境变化。

title: On the Stability of Social Risk Preferences for Health and Wealth
title_zh: 关于健康与财富社会风险偏好稳定性的研究
authors: Arthur Attema (Erasmus University Rotterdam), Olivier L’haridon (CREM - Centre de recherche en économie et management - UNICAEN - Université de Caen Normandie - NU - Normandie Université - UR - Université de Rennes - CNRS - Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique), Gijs van de Kuilen (Tilburg University [Netherlands])
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study investigates the temporal and contextual stability of social risk preferences across health and wealth, focusing on both gains and losses. Using a large representative Dutch panel, we replicated the experimental design of Attema et al. (2023) which elicited social risk preferences through allocation decisions involving two anonymous recipients under risk. The design allows us to distinguish three dimensions of preferences: risk preferences, inequality aversion, and social risk preferences arising from trade-offs between risk and inequality, corresponding to utilitarian, ex-ante, and ex-post perspectives on social welfare. At the aggregate level, the main patterns documented in the original study are largely replicated: inequality aversion is prevalent and risk aversion is weaker in the loss domain than in the gain domain. At the individual level, however, stability is more limited. Test-retest correlations are positive but modest, and the proportion of identical choices across waves varies across domains and framings. Parametric estimations further reveal substantial heterogeneity in social risk preferences. A latent-class analysis identifies utilitarian preferences as the largest group, followed by ex-post and exante perspectives. Overall, the results highlight the coexistence of persistence, contextual effects, and heterogeneity in social risk preferences

title: How Lender Cost of Funds and Market Structure Shape Agricultural Interest Rates
title_zh: 贷款资金成本与市场结构如何塑造农业贷款利率
authors: Noah Miller, Chad Fiechter, Jennifer Ifft, Blaine Nelson, Francisco Scott
abstract: ABSTRACT This paper investigates how lenders' costs of funds affect agricultural loan interest rates. We use a matched sample of US farm‐loan data and lender‐specific cost of funds, and a farm fixed effects design, to estimate pass‐through, conditioning on borrower characteristics. We find modest average pass‐through of funding costs to farm loan interest rates, with meaningful differences across lender types and local market conditions. Our findings suggest that borrower characteristics and common macroeconomic trends remain central to agricultural loan pricing, but lender business models and local credit market structure also shape how changes in funding costs affect farm borrowing costs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了贷款机构的资金成本如何影响农业贷款利率。我们利用美国农场贷款数据与贷款机构特定资金成本的匹配样本，并采用农场固定效应模型，在控制借款人特征的情况下估计传导效应。研究发现，资金成本向农场贷款利率的平均传导程度较为温和，且在不同贷款机构类型和当地市场条件下存在显著差异。我们的结果表明，借款人特征和共同宏观经济趋势仍是农业贷款定价的核心因素，但贷款机构的商业模式和当地信贷市场结构同样影响着资金成本变化对农场借贷成本的作用路径。

title: Customer Acquisition, Business Dynamism and Aggregate Growth
title_zh: 客户获取、商业活力与总体增长
authors: Marek Ignaszak, Petr Sedláček
abstract: Abstract Business dynamism -- the process of firm entry, growth and exit -- lies at the heart of modern endogenous growth models. While productivity differences have traditionally been seen as the main driving forces of business dynamism, a growing body of evidence suggests that customer acquisition is at least as important. In light of this evidence, we propose a novel endogenous growth model in which innovating firms must first acquire customers to sell their products. Estimating our model with aggregate and firm-level data, we find that expansions of firms' customer bases (market sizes) boost their incentives to innovate and shift resources towards high-growth businesses (“gazelles”). Combined, these effects explain over 40% of aggregate growth and substantially change predictions about the efficacy of growth policies. Finally, we document support for key model predictions using firm-level micro-data.

title:
When is TSLS
                    Actually
                    LATE?
title_zh: TSLS何时实际上是LATE？
authors: Christine Blandhol, John Bonney, Magne Mogstad, Alexander Torgovitsky
abstract: Abstract Linear instrumental variable estimators, such as two-stage least squares (TSLS), are commonly interpreted as estimating non-negatively weighted averages of causal effects, referred to as local average treatment effects (LATEs). We examine whether the LATE interpretation actually applies to the types of TSLS specifications that are used in practice. We show that if the specification includes covariates—which most empirical work does—then the LATE interpretation does not apply in general. Instead, the TSLS estimator will, in general, reflect treatment effects for both compliers and always/never-takers, and some treatment effects for the always/never-takers will necessarily be negatively weighted. We show that the only specifications that have a LATE interpretation are “saturated” specifications that control for covariates nonparametrically, implying that such specifications are both sufficient and necessary for TSLS to have a LATE interpretation, at least without additional parametric assumptions. This result is concerning because, as we document, empirical researchers almost never control for covariates nonparametrically, and rarely discuss or justify parametric specifications of covariates. We apply our results to thirteen empirical studies and find strong evidence that the LATE interpretation of TSLS is far from accurate for the types of specifications actually used in practice. We offer concrete recommendations for practice motivated by our theoretical and empirical results.
